action_description: Applied a GEMM1-only warp-sliced FP4 dequantization path for scale_vec==32: one warp computes each gate/up intermediate output pair, lanes process disjoint 32-element K blocks with 128-bit packed FP4 loads, reduce x1/x2 partials in-warp, and store one mid value. The parent scalar stage1 remains as fallback and the grouped GEMM2/finalize path is unchanged.
